facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports that Nigeria is preparing a law to regulate AI through the National Digital Economy and E-Governance Bill, expected to be approved by the end of March, with a risk-based framework, annual impact assessments for high-risk AI systems and fines of up to 10 million naira or 2% of an AI provider's Nigerian revenue; the document gives no event date, so its published date is used.
